title: Reaction time
text: Run the test rested, in a quiet moment, with the same hand and device. Take the median of the taps; ignore the first practice tap. There is no published limit.
A clear slowdown against the personal baseline, or sleepiness that will not lift, goes to the crew medical officer before safety-critical tasks.
design_note: Baseline scoring only: no published single-reading limit.

citations.title: A Meta-Analysis of the Impact of Short-Term Sleep Deprivation on Cognitive Variables
